note: 🗣️ The language-neutral roster of every user-visible generation3d label, one row per `app_labels!` field. The `app_labels!` macro already makes a MISSING locale a compile error; this fixture is what catches a locale that is PRESENT but wrong — English pasted into the German slot, or an empty string — and it pins the exact text both the Rust law (against `Generation3dLabels`' own consts) and the TypeScript twin (structural: every row bilingual, German distinct unless declared identical) answer. A label added without German fails both halves. Ticket 26/09/09/PROCEDURAL-3D-END-TO-END.
identicalByDesignNote: 🟰️ Fields whose German is legitimately the SAME word as the English — a proper noun or an international term. Every other field must differ, or the German slot was never translated.
